§6Singularity§f

§aA contained gravitational anomaly. Drop it and reality breaks.§f

§bSingularities§f are exotic matter constructs that serve as DFC cores. Each type has a different power multiplier for your reactor.

§6Base Singularity§f:
Crafted in a table: §e4 Euphemium Nuggets§f + §e2 Antischrabidium Cells§f + §e1 Block of Schrabidium§f. The starting point.

§6Upgrades§f:
§b• Superheated Resonating§f, adds energy powder and advanced alloy plates. §e500×§f multiplier.
§b• Contained Counter-Resonant§f, adds CMB steel and magnetized tungsten. §e650×§f multiplier.
§b• Miniature Black Hole§f, §e6 Artificial Xen Crystals§f + Singularity. §e800×§f multiplier, infinite duration.
§b• Spark Singularity§f, DNT compound plates + counter-resonant + superheated + miniature black hole. §e2,500×§f multiplier.

§cWARNING:§f Singularities break containment and become black holes if dropped. The base singularity lasts §e30§f seconds, superheated and counter-resonant last §e50§f, and the miniature black hole is permanent. Spark singularity lasts §e160§f seconds. Only the singularity screwdriver is safe to drop.

§ePS:§f The core type directly determines your DFC's power output. A Spark Singularity gives §e5×§f more power than a Vibrant Singularity.
